name: Hyperlinks
description: Represents the collection of hyperlinks for a worksheet or range.
remarks: Each hyperlink is represented by a Hyperlink object.
example:
For Each h in Worksheets(1).Hyperlinks
 If Instr(h.Name, "Microsoft") <> 0 Then h.Follow
Next

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of objects in the collection.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Returns a single object from a collection.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Anchor As Object, Address As String, [SubAddress As Variant], [ScreenTip As Variant], [TextToDisplay As Variant]) As Object
methods.description: Adds a hyperlink to the specified range or shape.

parameters.name: Anchor
parameters.description: The anchor for the hyperlink. Can be either a Range or Shape object.

parameters.name: ScreenTip
parameters.description: The screen tip to be displayed when the mouse pointer is paused over the hyperlink.

parameters.name: TextToDisplay
parameters.description: The text to be displayed for the hyperlink.
